}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "MKS Pi V1.1" is silkscreened on top of board. Makerbase logo and "Makerbase" are silkscreened on bottom of board.
===Specifications=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3328 @1.5GHz 64-bit :Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) Processor *GPU: ''Mali-450 MP2'' (supporting 4K @60fps) :Video decoding via VP9 or 10-bit H265/H264 *Storage: TF card (128GB)/MMC card slot, :eMMC module connector *Memory: 1GB (DDR3) SDRAM *Network: 1x 100MbE (Fast Ethernet) port *USB: 2x USB 2.0 Host, 1x USB 3.0 Host ports *Power: 12-24V via 2-pin Molex
